clues.text: A French city on the Mediterranean Sea, on the south-east coast. It is one of the largest French cities on that shore.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the south-east Mediterranean coast of France

source.quote: Located on the French Riviera, the southeastern coast of France on the Mediterranean Sea, at the foot of the French Alps, Nice is the second-largest French city on the Mediterranean coast

clues.text: Winters here are mild, not harsh and cold. Rich folk from cold lands came to spend each winter here.
clues.narrowing: rules out French coastal cities with harsh cold winters; points to a mild-winter resort coast

source.quote: The natural environment of the Nice area and its mild Mediterranean climate came to the attention of the English upper classes in the second half of the 18th century, when an increasing number of aristocratic families began spending their winters there.

clues.text: Greek settlers from Marseille founded this town around 350 BC. They named it for their goddess of victory.
